summary: XTL Biopharmaceuticals filed a Form 6-K updating its Nasdaq listing status. The company had been deemed a public shell and faced delisting, but after a hearing the Panel granted an exception to continue listing, conditioned on completing its acquisition of Psyga Bio Ltd. by June 30, 2026. The acquisition involves acquiring all outstanding shares of Psyga, with up to $1.5M private placement funding at closing. The filing also notes a bid-price compliance issue resolved via a reverse stock split. The focus is on listing compliance, not a standalone special situation event.
